scenes.script:
Miss Nova says: Meeru English matladeyappudu enduku freeze aypotaro telusa?
Miss Nova says: Endukante, kevalam chadavadam valla English matladadam raadu. Meeru actually out loud ga matladali.
Miss Nova says: Kani vere vallatho practice cheyyalante bhayam. Mana mistakes chusi judge chestharemo ani tension.
Miss Nova says: Nene Miss Nova, Supernova AI lo mee personal AI teacher. Naatho meeru veyyi mistakes chesina, nenu mimmalni eppudu chusi navvanu.

scenes.script:
Miss Nova says: Nenu andariki oke boring lessons ivvanu.
Miss Nova says: Mee exact level ni analyze chesi, mee kosam oka personalized plan ready chesthanu.
Miss Nova says: Mana next job-interview leda client call lanti real-life situations ni kalisi practice chestham.
Miss Nova says: Inka meeru ekkadaina stuck ayipothe, logic ni direct ga Telugu lone explain chesthanu, so that meeru easily understand cheskovachu.

parsed.self_critique_fixed: Applied the T7 hook rule by opening with a native Telugu word ('Meeru') instead of starting directly with 'English'. Ensured Miss Nova uses the warm, polite plural register ('meeru', 'cheyandi', 'mimmalni') throughout. Successfully code-mixed standard daily-speech English terms per T2 while keeping the sentence structure entirely natural and conversational (T3). Localized 'your own language' to 'Telugu' in Scene 2 per T5.
